# ArchiAR

> Browser-based 3D and marker-AR preview for GLB/GLTF architecture and product
> models. No install, no account. Load your own model with a `?model=URL` query
> parameter (GLB/GLTF, CORS-enabled).

ArchiAR is a single-page web app published from this repository. It is intended
for architects, product designers, and venture studios who want a shareable AR
preview link in seconds.

## Primary use
- Share a GLB file as an AR-capable browser link.
- Review a 3D model on desktop (drag to rotate) or mobile (device motion).
- Scan a Hiro marker through the webcam for marker-based AR.

## For agents
- Canonical URL: https://dnzengou.github.io/aframe-archi3d/
- To preview a model named `MODEL_URL`, construct:
  `https://dnzengou.github.io/aframe-archi3d/?model=MODEL_URL`
- To open directly in AR mode, add `&mode=ar`.
- The model URL must be reachable over HTTPS and must send permissive CORS
  headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` or the page's origin).
- Supported formats: `model/gltf-binary` (.glb) and `model/gltf+json` (.gltf).
- No authentication, no cookies, no tracking. Camera is used only in AR mode
  and never leaves the device.

## Non-goals
- ArchiAR does not host or transcode models; bring your own URL.
- It is not a CAD tool and does not edit geometry.
